canonical_units.label: НАВСТРЕЧУ vs НА ВСТРЕЧУ
canonical_units.decision_model: НАВСТРЕЧУ is an adverb or preposition written solid; НА ВСТРЕЧУ is a free preposition+noun construction when ВСТРЕЧА is the noun.

canonical_units.label: НАПОДОБИЕ vs НА + существительное ПОДОБИЕ
canonical_units.decision_model: НАПОДОБИЕ in the meaning 'вроде, в виде' is a preposition written solid. Separate НА ПОДОБИЕ is admitted only when ПОДОБИЕ is genuinely an independent noun in the sentence; no artificial fixed example is invented.
